package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Carrier is the construction bypass: nothing in NewCarrier's signature mentions Queries, so
// guard 3 (which checks signatures) never fires -- yet the body builds a fully scoped Queries
// field by field, without ever calling NewQueries, and hands it out through an exported field.
// Every guard before this one asked what a function returns; none asked what constructs a
// Queries.
type Carrier struct{ Q *Queries }

func NewCarrier(pool *pgxpool.Pool) *Carrier {
	return &Carrier{Q: &Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}}
}

// zeroQueries is the same violation in its cheapest form. It is fail-closed today only by
// accident of nil fields -- the rule is unconditional, so an empty composite counts too, and
// this literal must be reported exactly like the fully populated one above.
var zeroQueries = Queries{}
